Ava (PM): Quick sync — PRD acceptance gates for GenAPI v1. We have two customer asks: 1) strict 95th latency <= 600ms for paid tiers, 2) graceful degrade to cheaper model under load. Need clear acceptance criteria before launch. Who owns SLO calc?
Sam (Eng): I'll take SLO calc. Quick Q: is 600ms p95 cold-start included? presubmit requires warm RPS sim.
Ava (PM): Exclude cold-starts for Dedicated customers, include them for Hosted. Add note in PRD.
Li (SRE): We need error-budget math. If p95=600ms target, what's current baseline? From canary it's ~820ms under 1.5x. We need mitigation plan: prefix cache, KV warming, and automatic fallback to lower-cost model.
Sam (Eng): Agreed. Proposed fallback config snippet: 
```yaml
slo:
  p95_latency_ms: 600
  error_budget_pct: 0.5
fallbacks:
  - condition: cpu>80% or p95>600
    action: route_to: model-quant8
    preserve_kv_cache: true
```
Eve (CS): Customers told us they'd accept a short quality drop if latency improves, but they want explicit comms and Enterprise opt-in.
Ava (PM): Draft acceptance criteria: p95 <= 600ms for Hosted paid plans sustained over 72h; error budget burn < 5% per week; documented fallback modes + opt-in for Enterprise. Also require rollback/playbook.
Sam (Eng): Engineering checklist: perf test that simulates 3x peak for 2h and verify p95 after cache warming; add automated regression test; include canary config.
Li (SRE): Add alerting runbooks: p95 spike -> notify oncall and start gradual traffic shift: 20% to fallback after 5min sustained, 50% after 15min. If error budget burned > threshold, trigger emergency rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for canary-2025-06-12-17: nodes=4 region=us-west-2.
Ava (PM): Action items: Sam -> perf tests + PRD perf section, Li -> alerting + runbook, Eve -> customer comms + opt-in flow. I'll update PRD and tag reviewers. Ping here if anything blocks. :raised_hands:
